create_sentence_transformers_params: create a SentenceTransformersParams instance to configure sentence transformer training with custom learning rate and epochs
configure_sentence_transformers_model: configure SentenceTransformersParams to use a different pre-trained model like sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
set_sentence_transformers_trainer: set the trainer type in SentenceTransformersParams to pair_class for classification tasks with sentence pairs
configure_sentence_transformers_columns: configure SentenceTransformersParams column mappings for sentence1, sentence2, and target columns in the dataset
review_sentence_transformers_params: review the SentenceTransformersParams class to understand all available training hyperparameters and defaults
